w: One of roughly 130 secondhand bookshops packed into Jimbocho, the neighbourhood Time Out crowned the world's coolest in 2025. Founded in 1913, Isseido trades in antique woodblock prints, old maps and first editions across three narrow floors, a working archive of Tokyo's century-old book town.
